title: Flying Dogs
description: Now wolves can fly and now they are more dangerous
body:
# Flying Dogs 

Ever wished your dog could keep up with you in the sky? With Flying Dogs, your loyal companion is no longer limited to the ground.

Once you tame a dog, it gains the ability to fly and will follow you wherever you go — even high above the world. Whether you're exploring mountains, flying through the air, or fighting airborne mobs, your dog will always be right beside you.

**Features:**

* Tamed dogs can fly
* Dogs follow you in the air
* Dogs can attack flying mobs
* Smooth and natural flying behavior
* No commands or setup needed — just tame and go

Flying Dogs keeps things simple while making your adventures more fun. Your best friend is now truly by your side… even in the sky
